content.text: What You Can Actually Get Done Today

The first step towards accepting crypto payments is to understand that it's not a complex, long-term project. With the right infrastructure, you can deploy a functional commerce stack in a matter of hours, not days or weeks. This means you can start accepting payments from customers worldwide, without relying on traditional payment gateways. The key is to focus on the minimum viable product that works, rather than getting bogged down in unnecessary features or prerequisites.
The Minimum Viable Stack That Works

A basic commerce stack consists of a hosting platform, a backend logic provider, an order storage system, and a payment processing gateway. For hosting, you can use GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, both of which offer free plans. For backend logic, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script can handle the task, also for free. Supabase or Google Sheets can store orders, and NOWPayments can verify crypto payments automatically, with a minimal 0.5% fee. This stack is not only cost-effective but also highly reliable and scalable.
Skipping the Steps That Do Not Matter Yet

Many creators get caught up in details that don't immediately impact their ability to accept payments. Features like custom domain setup, advanced analytics, or intricate marketing automation can be added later. The priority should be getting a functional payment system live, so you can start earning revenue. Once the basic stack is deployed, you can refine and expand it based on your needs and customer feedback. This agile approach ensures you're not wasting time on non-essential features when you could be making sales.
Deploy your commerce stack in under 48 hours.
Getting Your First Transaction Live

Deploying your commerce stack is just the first step; the real milestone is processing your first transaction. With NOWPayments, you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, giving your customers a wide range of payment options. The automatic webhook feature ensures that once a payment is confirmed on-chain, your system is notified, and the transaction can be fulfilled instantly. This seamless process enhances the customer experience and builds trust in your brand, encouraging repeat business and positive word-of-mouth.
What to Do in the Next 24 Hours

The next 24 hours are critical in setting up your sovereign commerce infrastructure. Start by selecting your hosting and backend logic providers, then set up your order storage system. Integrate NOWPayments into your stack, and configure it to accept the cryptocurrencies you wish to support. Finally, test your stack with a small transaction to ensure everything is working as expected. This rapid deployment strategy gets you into the market quickly, allowing you to adapt and improve based on real-world feedback and sales data.

The Complete Builder Kit, available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for $197, offers a comprehensive solution for creators looking to establish their own commerce infrastructure. It includes all the necessary blueprints and templates to deploy a fully functional stack, complete with automatic crypto payment processing and instant product delivery.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy your commerce stack, follow these steps: Choose a hosting platform like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Select a backend logic provider such as Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Set up an order storage system with Supabase or Google Sheets. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment verification. Configure your stack to accept the desired cryptocurrencies. Test your setup with a small transaction to ensure everything works correctly. By following these steps, you can establish a sovereign commerce infrastructure that allows you to accept payments from customers worldwide, without relying on traditional platforms.
